create_class_Rotate: create a Rotate transform that applies random rotation with configurable min and max angles
create_class_Resize: create a Resize transform that randomly resizes images within a configurable size ratio range
create_class_Crop: create a Crop transform that randomly crops images within a configurable size ratio range
create_class_Perspective: create a Perspective transform that applies random perspective distortion with configurable distortion scale
create_class_HorizontalFlip: create a HorizontalFlip transform that flips images horizontally
